'''Knowledge Demon''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Knowledge Demon}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Curse of Knowledge
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Each player chooses one of two debuffs to receive. The options change each time this move is used.
|GivesToPlayer = Disintegration, Mind Rot, Sloth, Waste Away
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Slap
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (17;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Knowledge Overwhelming
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage ×3.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Ponder
|Intent = Attack3, Heal, Buff
|Effect = Deals (11;{{Asc2|9|13}}) damage. Heals 30 HP per player. Gains (2;{{Asc2|9|3}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength, Heal
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Knowledge Demon repeats a fixed four-move cycle:
# {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Curse of Knowledge}}
# {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Slap}}
# {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Knowledge Overwhelming}}
# {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Ponder}}

After the third {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Curse of Knowledge}} (once all three status sets have been offered), the cycle changes: {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Curse of Knowledge}} is skipped, and the remaining three moves repeat in order.

=== Dialogue ===
When using {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Curse of Knowledge}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS|||Make your choice.}}
</i></blockquote>
After a debuff has been chosen.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS|||It is done.}}
</i></blockquote>

== Notes ==
* {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Curse of Knowledge}} status sets:
** Set 1: {{BD2|Disintegration}} (6 damage/turn) or {{BD2|Mind Rot}} (draw 1 fewer card/turn)
** Set 2: {{BD2|Disintegration}} (7 damage/turn) or {{BD2|Sloth}} (max 3 cards/turn)
** Set 3: {{BD2|Disintegration}} (8 damage/turn) or {{BD2|Waste Away}} (1 less {{KW2|Energy}}/turn)
* The debuffs from {{Int2|Knowledge Demon|Curse of Knowledge}} are shown as cards, but are never added to the player's hand or deck. Once chosen, they are instantly played and removed from the game.

== Useful Cards ==
* In order to deal with the extra damage from {{BD2|Disintegration}}, you can either use strong defensive cards like {{C2|Footwork}} or {{C2|Feel No Pain}}, or simply enter the battle with a significant HP pool and finish off the '''Knowledge Demon''' before it can kill you. If you cannot afford to take this extra damage, it may be a good idea to take cards which make the other options less harmful.
* Strength reduction from cards like {{C2|Piercing Wail}} or {{C2|Monarch's Gaze}} can make multihitting attacks much less deadly.
* Strong draw from cards like {{C2|Acrobatics}} or {{C2|Machine Learning}} can make {{BD2|Mind Rot}} less impactful.
* {{R2|Runic Pyramid}} makes {{BD2|Mind Rot}} significantly less of a problem by saving cards from previous turns.
* {{C2|Pyre}} can make up for the energy loss from {{BD2|Waste Away}}.
* Strong, expensive cards like {{C2|Impervious}} and {{C2|Ice Lance}} are an effective way to use your limited card plays after taking {{BD2|Sloth}}.
* The {{R2|Pocketwatch}} can help make up for the limited draw from {{BD2|Mind Rot}}, and as long as you are already playing only 3 cards per turn to activate it, {{BD2|Sloth}} is essentially harmless.
